BiblicalUsage: One word, one verse: in Hebrews 11:36 the heroes of faith had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, of bonds and imprisonment — mockery listed among the sufferings that faith endures.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mockery is a real cost of faith, and the fact that Scripture names it beside scourgings tells me God sees the words that wound, not only the blows.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
